summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on an observed discrepancy in how facility and frame statuses are aggregated. Specifically, a case was presented where the system appeared to treat a facility as disabled from 2025-12-10 to 2025-12-23, while the underlying data suggested different enabled/disabled periods for the single associated frame (e.g., enabled until 2025-12-16, then disabled until 2025-12-23, and re-enabled). The core issue is that the aggregation seems to incorrectly calculate an uninterrupted period of unavailability.

It was clarified that the investigation should focus on frame data rather than general facility status fields like `is_active` or simple dictionary views. Someone acknowledged that the view used for facility status might be incorrect, and [me] stated they would investigate this potential issue.
decisions: The discrepancy in facility/frame status aggregation needs investigation.
action_items: [me] will investigate the potentially incorrect view related to facility status.
